Ignatius endures twelve days alone in the sealed control room as the submarine drifts in the deep abyss.
Ignatius endures another twelve days in the silent, freezing submarine as something stirs below.
Ignatius curls against the bulkhead, succumbing to the cold and the darkness of the deep.

The Long Sleep

[SCENE_SETTING]
The pale bioluminescence fades into a gentle, silvery twilight that stretches across an endless, silent sea floor. No cold touches the skin here, and the heavy roar of the machine has dissolved into a quiet, rhythmic pulse like a distant heartbeat. Time ceases its frantic march, leaving only the tranquil drift of floating spores and the weightless peace of the abyss. Here, the deep claims its own, wrapping them in an eternal, dreamless quiet.

[STORY]
[narrator] The last frayed thread of consciousness snaps, and the cold ache of the mortal world melts away into a profound, fathomless peace. 
[narrator] In the quiet corridors of the deep, the story of Ignatius Crow comes to its final, silent close, carried away by the gentle currents of an ocean that remembers everything.

[CHAPTER]
The Salt and the Sand

[SCENE_SETTING]
Warm morning sunlight spills across a wide expanse of pale quartz sand, glinting off the crests of gentle, turquoise waves. A salty breeze carries the sharp scent of drying kelp and sun-warmed driftwood, rustling through the tall dune grass just beyond the reach of the tide. Gulls wheel lazily in the cloudless blue overhead, their cries faint and musical against the steady, rhythmic murmur of the surf. Here, far from the crushing darkness of the abyss, the world begins entirely anew.

[STORY]
[narrator] The heavy weight of the deep ocean dissolves, replaced by the startling warmth of a sun-drenched beach and the rhythmic whisper of breaking waves.
[narrator] You draw in a deep, lung-bursting breath of salt air, blinking against the brilliant light as gentle tide pools lap at your bare feet.
